interface.shortDescription: Daily product and engineering dashboards from your team's tools
interface.longDescription:
Devplan is the product intelligence layer for software teams. This plugin brings it into Codex.

Daily Radar, Demand Report, Engineering Analytics, Stale Commitments, Suggested Projects, Changelog and Customer Release Brief, refreshed daily, plus grounded specs with a discovery conversation, technical plan and estimate. Everything runs on the tools you already use: GitHub, Linear, Jira, Slack, Notion, Zendesk, Gong and more. Your tool data stays in your tools.

Sign in free to save your company context so every answer starts out knowing your company.

Connect Devplan to run everything on a shared knowledge graph: faster and cheaper (a few calls instead of dozens), always up to date, the same for your whole team, and people, customers and projects matched across every tool. $100 in free credits.
